raw_sections.summary:
Professional Summary
PRINCE2® Certified Project Manager with over 16 years of experience delivering end-to-end technology projects across banking, credit cards, merchant acquiring, and digital banking platforms. Strong expertise in project planning, execution, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and regulatory compliance within highly regulated environments. Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams, managing vendors, and delivering secure, scalable solutions on time and within budget.
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience Winjit Technologies — Project Manager Client - Equitas Small Finance Bank, India Post Payment Bank
Jul 2024 – Aug 2026
Domains: Credit Cards | Mobile Banking | Digital Channels
Managed end-to-end delivery of enterprise banking and digital transformation projects for leading financial institutions, including the Credit Card Web Journey and Credit Card Application for Equitas Bank, Mobile Banking and PSP Mobile Application solutions for India Post Payments Bank (IPPB), and a large-scale website modernization initiative. Accountable for project planning, scope, timelines, deliverables, quality, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Managed end-to-end regional migration activities for banking/card operations, coordinating transition from the source region to the target region across planning, dependencies, resource readiness, testing, cutover and BAU transition. Drove process standardisation across regional teams by reviewing variations in existing workflows and aligning procedures, controls and delivery practices to support consistent operations during and after migration.
Led project planning and execution across the complete delivery lifecycle, translating business objectives into actionable project plans, milestones, deliverables, resource requirements, and release schedules. Monitored project progress, identified deviations, managed dependencies, and implemented corrective actions to ensure on-time and within-scope delivery.
Maintained project plans, milestones, dependencies, forecasts and delivery status in Clarity, ensuring accurate tracking and governance throughout the project lifecycle. Identified and tracked non-standard scenarios and operational exceptions during migration, assessing impacts, coordinating resolution with business and technology stakeholders, and driving closure before go-live. Documented current-state and target-state processes and developed detailed SOPs/process documentation to support operational transition, standardisation, knowledge transfer and BAU readiness.
Managed and mentored cross-functional teams comprising Business Analysts, Java Developers, QA Engineers, UI/UX Designers, DevOps Engineers, Architects, and third-party vendors. Applied Agile and Waterfall methodologies based on project requirements and facilitated sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and delivery governance.
Served as the primary interface between clients, business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams, driving requirement workshops, solution discussions, project status reviews, stakeholder communications, executive updates, and decision-making. Built strong client relationships and ensured alignment on scope, priorities, timelines, and expected outcomes. • Coordinated SIT, UAT, production deployments, and post-production support in collaboration with QA, infrastructure, DevOps, application, and business teams. Managed defect triage, release readiness, deployment dependencies, user acceptance, production stabilization, and transition to business-as-usual operations.
• Drove process standardisation across regional teams by reviewing variations in existing
workflows and aligning procedures, controls and delivery practices to support consistent operations during and after migration. Managed third-party vendors and delivery dependencies, coordinating activities, tracking commitments, monitoring deliverables, and ensuring adherence to agreed timelines, quality standards, and project objectives.
Established effective project communication and governance mechanisms, including status reporting, milestone tracking, action and decision logs, risk/issue tracking, stakeholder updates, and delivery reviews, providing management with clear visibility into project health and progress.
TATA Consultancy Services — Consultant Client – Citibank
Sep 2021 – Oct 2023
Domain: Merchant Acquiring – eCommerce

Led large-scale initiatives covering merchant onboarding, funding, reconciliation, and scheme settlements (Visa / MasterCard).
Delivered critical regulatory and operational reports including QMR, QOC, and validated net settlement advisories.
Worked across platforms such as Fiserv and Global Payments, resolving high-impact operational and transaction-related issues.
Coordinated with product support, business, and technology teams to ensure seamless execution and regulatory compliance.
Hexaware Technologies —Project Manager Client – Citibank
Jan 2019 – Sep 2021
Commercial Card Product Enhancements
Defined and documented business and functional requirements for commercial card product enhancements.
Supported implementation of regulatory updates, product changes, and process improvements.

Led UAT planning, execution, coordination, and post-test validation, ensuring compliance with banking mandates.
Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders to improve product functionality and operational efficiency
Wipro Technologies — Project Lead Client - Lloyds Bank, Mastercard
Jan 2013 – Dec 2018

Served as Project Lead for card issuance and transaction processing systems, covering authorization, clearing, and settlement.
Acted as PMO Lead for Retail Transformation initiatives at Lloyds Banking Group, managing a 25-member delivery team.
Oversaw resource onboarding, shift planning, SLA tracking, delivery governance, and stakeholder reporting.
Maintained risk registers, issue logs, and escalation matrices, ensuring proactive communication and resolution.
IBM Global Services — Associate (Banking Operations) Client – Citibank
Jan 2010 – Sep 2011
•
Supported back-office operations for Home, Auto, and Personal Loans, ensuring adherence to process SLAs.
Handled customer disputes and service requests with a strong focus on accuracy, compliance, and documentation standards.
First Source Solutions — Customer Service Associate Sep 2007 – May 2009
Delivered Tier-1 customer support in telecom services, handling escalations and ensuring issue resolution in line with company SLAs.
